### POST `/api/documents/merge`

Phase 12.5: one batched query instead of one per requested document
id. merge_documents() relies on `documents`' order matching
payload.document_ids exactly (order's (doc_idx, page_number) pairs
index positionally into it) -- rebuild that order explicitly since
.in_() does not guarantee result order.

**Request body** (required): `application/json`: `MergeDocumentsRequest`

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json`: `DocumentOut` |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json`: `HTTPValidationError` |

### GET `/api/receipts`

Phase 12.1: previously unbounded -- returned every matching row in

entire receipts table on every call.

### POST `/api/receipts/{receipt_id}/reprocess`

Phase 11 (gap #2): retry extraction on an already-ingested receipt
(bad OCR, gateway was briefly down, etc.) -- the only prior
re-extraction trigger was the page-op routes above, which only ever
act on a newly-created derived Document. Mirrors the admin-action
trigger in app/admin.py's ReceiptAdmin.reprocess_receipts, same
pattern as this file's own _enqueue_page_op_reextraction.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `receipt_id` | path | yes | `string:uuid` |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json`: `ImportBatchOut` |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json`: `HTTPValidationError` |

### DocumentOut

receipt/extraction detail (ReceiptDetailOut covers that once
re-extraction finishes), just enough to confirm what was created and
its lineage.
